sourceVersion: P.L.2014 chapter31, original enacted text; subsequent amendments/current2026 consolidation NOT verified

terms.coverage: Complaint-warrant initial indictable or disorderly-persons charge, subject to statutory exceptions
terms.releasePriority: Primarily nonmonetary release; least restrictive conditions reasonably assuring appearance, safety and no obstruction.
terms.monetaryBail: Permitted only when no other conditions reasonably assure appearance; monetary bail is not categorically abolished.
terms.detention: Prosecutor motion and clear-and-convincing finding that no conditions reasonably assure statutory goals.

mappingCorrection: Existing yes/no end-cash-bail label cannot represent these exceptions. Submit structured release-condition terms through coordinator; do not equate yes with universal release or zero detention.
why: Court applies statutory release constraints to the charged defendant's case record.
Nonmonetary release removes the payment condition only when the applicable legal findings authorize it.
A legal rule sets the court's permissible conditions; a person's ability to pay cannot override those conditions.
conditions: Charge, warrant/summons, judicial findings, failure-to-appear and detention-hearing exceptions must be read from operative statute.
reverseOnRepeal: Replacement law governs future release decisions at its effective date; do not retroactively undo detention, payments or prior decisions.
who: Eligible charged defendants and the court/pretrial-services records, not all residents.
lagWhy: Statutory decision deadline is48hours subject to sections4/5 exceptions; this is not a causal aggregate detention lag.

cost.missing: Current NJ pretrial-services/court operating appropriation, covered caseload and marginal per-case cost; no invented fiscal rate.
